verdict.rationale: Stable is a SaaS that stores scanned mail, OCR results and AI summaries, so choosing a data-storage region is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never mentions data residency or a choice of storage region. Picking a physical mailbox or registered-agent location by IATA or state code is an adjacent feature: it sets where physical mail is received, not where data is stored, so it earns no credit.
